## Functions

### `SidebarLayout`

```ts
SidebarLayout(props: SidebarLayoutProps): Html
```

Header + side navigation + content. The app frame.

## Types

### `SidebarLayoutProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Html` |  | Usually a `Navbar`. The drawer toggle is added in front of it. |
| `sidebar` | `Html` | yes | A `Sidebar` component whose `id` equals `sidebarId`. |
| `sidebarId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `content` | `Html` | yes |  |
| `aside` | `Html` |  | Secondary column beside the content (activity feed, filters). |
| `footer` | `Html` |  |  |
| `side` | `"start" | "end"` |  |  |
| `width` | `"fluid" | "boxed"` |  |  |
| `stickyHeader` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `drawerToggle` | `boolean` |  | Set false if the header already contains its own `SidebarToggle`. |
| `contentId` | `string` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |
